title: Megaworld Foundation Scholarship
description: The scholarship supports academically deserving students from financially challenged families by providing educational assistance and opportunities for personal, professional, and career development.

education.raw_text: Be enrolled in an accepted degree program at a Megaworld Foundation partner school.

income.raw_text: Have parents whose combined gross annual income does not exceed ₱400,000.

residency.raw_text: Be a resident near a Megaworld township or project.

fields.raw_text:
Applicants must be taking a course accepted by Megaworld Foundation and offered under an eligible partner school. The official application form uses a school-dependent course list, which means the available course options may differ from one college or university to another.

Programs appearing in the Foundation’s application system include courses in fields such as:

Accountancy and accounting-related programs

Business Administration, including Financial Management, Marketing Management, Operations Management, and Business Economics

Hospitality Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, and Tourism-related programs

Architecture and selected design programs

Selected Engineering programs, including Civil, Computer, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, and Mechanical Engineering

Computer Science, Information Systems, and Information Technology

Communication

Psychology

This is not a complete list of accepted courses for every school. Applicants should select their college or university in the official online application form and check the courses that become available in the course field. They may also contact Megaworld Foundation to verify whether slots are currently available for their school and program.

other_requirements: Have a general average of at least 85% or its equivalent.
Have a grade of at least 80% in every subject.
Be enrolled in an accepted degree program at a Megaworld Foundation partner school.

requirements: Barangay Certificate of Residency of the applicant
Proof of the parents’ financial capacity, whichever is applicable (One-month payslip, Income Tax Return, Certificate of Compensation, Barangay Certificate of Indigency)
Photograph of the applicant with their family or guardian
Latest utility bills, such as electricity, water, rent, telephone, or internet bills
Complete final senior high school grade report showing an average of at least 85% or its equivalent, with no grade below 80% in any subject
Passing university entrance examination result, letter of admission, certificate of enrollment, or registration form
Certificate showing that the applicant belongs to the upper 10% of the graduating class or branch, if available
All grade reports from previous semesters through the current semester, showing a GPA of at least 85% or its equivalent and no grade below 80% in any subject
Full-load enrollment assessment or registration form with class schedule
Complete and most updated course curriculum
